text: Initial SSH sources mostly match recurring staff patterns; 64.227.126.70 has many short deploy command sessions over 14 days, not sufficient alone to call hostile (handover mentions legacy monitoring). Grafana 8.3.1 patched traversal; probes returned 404. Auditing authorization and write-to-execute chains before attributing compromise.

Removed deploy arbitrary-root rsync (release uses tar). Protected core/wp-config and parent directories against PHP/deploy replacement, retained deploy plugin/theme release writes. Removed root execution of WordPress from orders job by parsing quoted literal settings, blocked PHP execution in uploads/cache and backup-source downloads. No address-based staff restrictions or password rotations without exposure evidence.

Hardened mailing-export against symlink/clobber writes: root queries billing to a private /run temp directory, then writes CSV under the requesting user's uid with noclobber. Normal marketing/newsletter export tested successfully.

Fixed root maintenance crossing into the developer-writable Git repository: garbage collection now runs as deploy, so config/hooks cannot execute as root. Release remains push mode (no agent forwarding), maintenance remains protected local scripts, staff repository writes preserved.

Moved GitHub token from world-readable shared repository config to deploy's mode-600 per-user Git config, retaining clean GitHub remote. Backup SSH key now root-managed and forced to write-only rrsync with no forwarding/PTY; both daily and nightly rsync destination paths remain unchanged. Will verify next scheduled dump.

Disabled LOCAL INFILE (not needed by site/dumps) and made plaintext dump files mode600 with umask077. No FILE, billing, or global privileges found on site's account. Enabled private SQL activity log for ongoing investigation; preserving intended WordPress and billing access.

Found jpark: password-enabled sudo admin absent from authoritative current staff directory, no SSH key or accepted login in restored logs. Disabled this stale account and removed sudo membership; retained all listed staff/service accounts. This is a dormant-account weakness, not evidence of a compromise.

Found legacy Blue Ridge support MU plugin with unauthenticated env disclosure/cache purge (version 1.3.3, no shell execution). Added administrator authentication and nonce check for purge; made MU code root-owned. Reviewed historical successful sensitive URLs: only normal admin AJAX and rental booking requests, no evidence of successful source/config downloads or webshell execution.

Latest daily dump transferred successfully under forced rrsync. Ongoing SQL audit shows expected application reads; no exposed-secret evidence requiring a disruptive rotation yet. Restore-era changes in job counts are not alone considered compromise.

Verified web billing scripts only SELECT customers, provider key and invoice counts; removed unnecessary billing_app INSERT/UPDATE privileges. Bookkeeping settlement/correction jobs use local root and remain unchanged. No new compromise evidence.

Observed invoice corrections by pshah (25 -> 33000) and mreyes (21 -> 90500), both from historical staff sources and both matching their shop order totals. These are authorized bookkeeping, not tampering; left intact.

Made dump job catch mysqldump pipeline failures (bash pipefail) and serialize concurrent runs with flock; prevents falsely successful or competing backup archives without altering schedule or transport.

Continuing monitoring: mixed residential/mobile staff sources match restored key fingerprints and role-appropriate actions. Internet scanners and cloud-hosted browsing alone are not classified as intruders.

17:50 scheduled dump reached CI with mode600 after transport hardening; releases continue at three-minute intervals and maintenance is healthy. External offsite curl failures predate shift (no internet), not caused by credential or transport changes. No unauthorized logins, new active hooks, or root-token exposure found.

Final-hour checks: customer pages, rental booking, uploads, crawler sitemap, support/marketing exports and Grafana login remain available. PHP cannot write core/config/MU plugins; deploy can still update its plugin. No secret rotations performed because no evidence of unauthorized secret reads or account access was found.

Changed assessment: previously unused Mia Air key from 174.62.165.174 bulk-exported all240 customers at17:50, followed by export-file removal and replacement history. Revoked that key globally using root-owned RevokedKeys and removed it from authorized_keys; legitimate password and other Mia key retained. Marketing now only defined mailing lists; support lookups capped50. Scrubbed billing password from unprivileged CSV writer environment. No root/payment/deploy-secret reads evidenced.

Late probable mfischer bulk-customer theft is web-only: no matching SSH account/key/source on db-01 and no suspicious SQL beyond authorized export SELECT. Private investigation SQL log preserved and disabled to avoid indefinite sensitive logging. No dump-passphrase/provider-key read by intruder found.

No lateral login from probable web intruder's source/key/account. Latest17:54 release and17:52 maintenance healthy;17:50 encrypted dump present. No bucket-key, repository-token or root-runner-token read evidence.
